request.description: Original Pulp Wars chunky clean 2D strategy-game illustration, playful board-game sticker, strong dark colored outline, mostly flat colors, two-level cel shading, minimal texture, simple highlight, intentionally drawn rather than rendered, charming silly adventurous tone. Palette: naval gray and desaturated blue-gray armored steel hull, cream bridge windows, muted bronze gun details, charcoal-teal outline and southeast planes, one blank coral ownership panel. Ruleset 7 Original Battleship world sprite. One recognizable LONG BROAD LOW-WIDE ARMORED STEEL WARSHIP in three-quarter view, pointed bow unmistakably at lower-right / southeast and stern at upper-left. Hull at least 1.7 times wider than tall and much larger than Patrol Boat. Show TWO separated substantial HEAVY MULTI-BARREL TURRETS: one forward and one aft, each with two large parallel barrels. Between them: one compact central BRIDGE / SUPERSTRUCTURE and one obvious FUNNEL, low enough to keep both turrets readable. Closed armored deck and hull. One contiguous blank coral ownership panel covers about ten percent. Strong dark outline, broad flat fills, two-to-three shade levels, northwest light. Transparent untrimmed 384 by 384, preferred alpha x30..354 y82..308, keel anchor 192,288. Isolated ship only. Must not include: pixel-art grid, detailed pixel art, photorealism, painterly brushwork, realistic anatomy, realistic lighting, faux 3D, low-poly 3D, gradients, complex ambient light, tiny texture, intricate costume, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI frame, selection ring, health bar, cast shadow, ground plane, matte, halo, cropped silhouette, blur, gore; open cockpit, open passenger well, wooden dinghy, timber hull, rowboat, fishing boat, sailboat, pirate ship, mast-driven silhouette, lone cannon, single turret, light patrol gun, missing aft turret, missing forward turret, single-barrel heavy turret, tall narrow ship, tall tower, bow at left, west-facing ship, cannon fire, projectile, wake, water, foam.
